about_the_game:
Pixel Gun 2 is the wildest arena shooter out there—and it doesn’t care about limits.

Throw yourself into fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled gunfights where chaos reigns, weapons combine in impossible ways, and wins don’t just happen—they create legends. Whether you're an OG pixelgunner or a fresh frag-hunter, there’s something here with your name on it.

  • Build your own insane loadouts

Min-max like a pro, or throw logic out the window and go full wildcard. Either way—you’re dangerous.

  • Dominate the arena

Maps aren’t just for movement—they’re for mayhem. Use each and every block and pixel to your advantage—or become someone else’s kill count.

  • Surf the madness

Explore game modes that go way beyond what you'd expect. Think you’ve seen it all? We’ve got a few surprises up our sleeve

  • Skill it or chill it

Whether you're chasing sweaty leaderboard spots, reliving that nostalgic PG magic, or just passing time with style—Pixel Gun 2 delivers. If you're having fun, you're doing it right.

  • Become part of the legend

Classic PG helped define mobile shooters for a generation. Pixel Gun 2 takes all the best from that heritage and turns it up to 200%. You're not just playing—you’re joining a shooter saga. Everyone in Pixel Gun 2 is a sibling-in-arms... until they’re frags.

  • And limits?

Yeah... we respawn past those.

And this is just the beginning! There’s so much more coming to Pixel Gun 2—and you’ll be in the loop every step of the way. The trigger-happy party’s about to go off. You do not wanna miss this. WISHLIST NOW!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.15
  • Processor: Intel i5 @ 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: no
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Mac OS X 12
  • Processor: Intel i7 family (3.8 GHz and above) | Apple M1
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 5700 (or any other with 8 GB or more of video memory)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: no

name: Pixel Gun 2

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64) - Windows 11 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4th Generation and above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 600 Series or equivalent or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: no

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64) - Windows 11 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen R5 1600 processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: Say hello to your new favorite arena shooter—Pixel Gun 2! Build insane gun combos, flex your skills, or just surf the chaos. Limits? Nah, we respawn past those. Whatever you're lookin’ for—nostalgia, hardcore competition, pure fun, or just a time-killer—you get it here. Every time. Wishlist now!
